_comment: Zen keyboard shortcut overrides. Only the bindings that differ from Zen's
shipped defaults live here; the deploy script merges them onto whatever
table Zen generated, so a version bump that regenerates the defaults does
not fight a pinned copy of all ~128 entries.
Chord syntax: Ctrl / Alt / Shift joined by +, key last. Ctrl maps to Zen's
'accel' modifier (Ctrl on Linux). VK_* names bind a keycode, not a char.
Super/Meta is deliberately unused: niri owns Mod as its compositor key and
would swallow the chord before Zen ever sees it.

retire.viewOpenTabsSidebarKb: sidebar.revamp is false and locked in Zen's defaults, so viewOpenTabsSidebar is never registered as a panel; the key only toggled the sidebar onto whatever panel was last open (bookmarks). Unbound to free Ctrl+Alt+U for zen-split-view-unsplit.
retire.toggleSidebarKb: Firefox's sidebar toggle, lands on the bookmarks panel. Zen's own zen-toggle-sidebar takes over Ctrl+Alt+Z.
